Diners are seated at the tables, and the staff is visible moving around the open-air dining area. (3) Two women wearing vibrant pink traditional Indian sarees are working in an open kitchen area. They are hand-rolling dough and cooking flatbread over a bright blue gas flame on a specialized metal stovetop. (4) The camera pans over various food items, including golden metal tiered containers, rolls of bread, and a main course presented inside a wooden chest. A hand is seen opening the chest to reveal plated food on a black slate. (5) The man is shown at his table, opening a small gold-colored cylindrical container to reveal a dessert. He uses a small fork to eat a piece of food and drinks a pale yellow beverage from a thin-stemmed glass. (6) A large round brass tray is shown, containing several small bowls filled with colorful sauces, pomegranate seeds, and yogurt, accompanied by several pieces of thin, toasted flatbread. (7) The man picks up a piece of the flatbread and eats it, followed by a close-up of him eating a white dessert that resembles a cluster of almonds on a golden plate. (8) He is seen drinking from a white porcelain tea cup and then waving towards the camera with a smile, while the palace building is shown again in the background at the end.
